newsitem.title: DUBAI: PLO official blames U.S. for stalled peace talks.
newsitem.headline: PLO official blames U.S. for stalled peace talks.

text.p: A senior Palestine Liberation Organisation official has blamed the United States for the stalled Middle East peace talks, of which it is a sponsor.
Farouk Kaddoumi, who heads the PLO's political department, told the United Arab Emirates' al-Khaleej newspaper that Washington was not giving proper attention to the peace process.
"The American laxness, slowdown and hesitation is the cause for what we have reached not only on the Palestinian track, but also on the Syrian and Lebanese tracks," he was quoted as saying.
"Truly, it seems that the United States has not given the proper attention and the necessary importance to the peace process...."
